title: Quickstart Sample Surgeon Lab Notes
content:
Attendees: Aisha, Marco, Priya, Evan

Context: small experimental spike to reduce friction in the quickstart flow. The goal of this lab is to surgically remove common failure modes in sample projects (node/python quickstarts + minimal infra) and document fixes so the quickstarts are reliable for first-time users and internal demos.

Agenda:
- Share recent failure telemetry from quickstart runner
- Walk through top-3 user-facing flakes found in last two weeks
- Agree on immediate fixes vs larger SDK changes
- Assign owners and timelines for follow-ups

Summary of telemetry (from quickstart-runner v2):
- 192 total runs (2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-28)
- Success rate overall: 78% (down from 85% after an upstream env change)
- Failures by symptom:
  - 34%: environment misconfiguration (missing API key format / env var names)
  - 25%: dependency mismatch (node gRPC vs SDK binding)
  - 18%: sample timeouts during model pull on low-bandwidth infra
  - 11%: docs/README mismatch with current CLI flags
  - 12%: misc (typos, platform OS differences)

Top-3 problems & root cause hypotheses:
1) API key env var drift
   - Symptom: quickstart scripts expect REDWOOD_API_KEY but onboarding flow set REDWOOD_KEY in some templates.
   - Hypothesis: historic rename of env var not fully propagated to sample templates and quickstart-runner.
   - Impact: newbie friction, manual troubleshooting in first 5-10 minutes.

2) Node sample runtime binding failure (grpc-native mismatch)
   - Symptom: `npm install` succeeds but `npm run start` crashes on native gRPC layer with ABI error on Node 18 on some ARM Macs.
   - Hypothesis: package-lock / optionalDependencies not pinned; CI built artifacts for x86-only binary; postinstall build not triggered reliably.
   - Impact: critical for PLG sign-up flow where devs try Node quickstart on Mac laptops.

3) Model pull timeouts for containerized quickstart on small VMs
   - Symptom: samples that pull a ~3GB quantized package time out in CI runners or low-tier cloud VMs (2 vCPU, 4GB RAM).
   - Hypothesis: default timeout (300s) too low for certain network conditions; no retry/backoff for download step.
   - Impact: intermittent failure that looks like 'sample broken' rather than 'infra too slow'.

Decisions made:
- Short-term fixes (this sprint):
  - Normalize env var names across samples/CLI/templates to REDWOOD_API_KEY and add a one-liner in README that checks for it. (owner: Aisha, ETA: 2026-10-04)
  - Add a pre-check script in node/python quickstarts that prints a helpful error when missing env vars and suggests the CLI `redwood config set --help`. (owner: Marco, ETA: 2026-10-06)
  - Pin or prefer pure-js fallback for Node grpc path in samples; add an optional note in package.json to trigger `npm rebuild` on known problematic platforms. (owner: Priya, ETA: 2026-10-11)
- Medium-term work (next two sprints):
  - Rework sample dependency manifests to use `install-from-lockfile` CI job that validates on x86 and ARM mac runners. (owner: Priya, linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842, ETA: 2026-10-20)
  - Implement download retry/backoff + progress indicator in sample bootstrap script; surface clearer failure message when model pull times out. (owner: Evan, ETA: 2026-10-18)

Action items (concrete):
- Aisha: push small README env var normalization PR and update quickstart-runner mapping (DX-789). Try to get it merged before next weekly demo. (due 2026-10-04)
- Marco: draft `preflight.sh` for linux/mac + an equivalent python check; add to both samples and quickstart CI. Put draft in PR for review. (due 2026-10-06)
- Priya: investigate optionalDependency pin strategy and create cross-platform CI job; coordinate with infra for ARM mac runners. (due 2026-10-11)
- Evan: implement retry/backoff for model pulls in bootstrap; add telemetry event `quickstart:model_pull_retry` for monitoring. (due 2026-10-18)
- Team: public post-mortem note for onboarding broken flows annotated into Confluence page (CONFLUENCE:DX/Quickstarts/Sample-Surgeon). Evan to start outline. (due 2026-10-08)

Open questions / risks:
- Do we want to start shipping lighter sample artifacts (smaller models) as the default quickstart experience? Pros: faster, fewer timeouts. Cons: may misrepresent full prod performance. Needs product alignment. (Action: Aisha to sync with Product Hosted API team next week)
- Do we standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY forever or add an alias layer in CLI that accepts both old/new names? Backward compatibility vs cleanup. (Decision deferred to next week)

Notes from the demo run (live):
- Marco reproduced the Node gRPC crash on his M1 with Node 18; quick patch that forces `npm rebuild grpc` made it runnable. Verified logs captured to: /tmp/quickstart-runner/logs/2026-09-29-node-gprc.txt
- Evan validated that adding a single extra retry with exponential backoff reduced observed pull failures from ~18% to ~6% in a limited test against slow mirror. Full rollout when telemetry is in.

Documentation updates required:
- README: env var section, preflight checklist, quick troubleshooting steps (owner: Aisha)
- Samples: add `diagnose.sh` and `diagnose.py` helper scripts that collect environment info and suggest fixes (owner: Marco)
- Release notes: include quickstart compatibility changes in next SDK patch (owner: Priya)

Follow-ups / Meetings:
- Mini sync (15m) on 2026-10-05 to check PR statuses and merge blockers. Invite: eng-developer-experience, solutions engineering. (owner: Aisha)
- Post-mortem doc draft due 2026-10-08 (Evan)

Quick wins to deploy immediately:
- Tweak quickstart-runner so missing API key yields a clear log and exit code 2 instead of stack trace. (done as experiment locally, push pending)
- Add a small FAQ snippet to the top-level samples index: "If install fails on mac M1, run: npm rebuild && node --enable-source-maps index.js"

Appendix: quick links and commands used during lab:
- Local recreate command (node sample): 
  git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples.git && cd samples/node-quickstart && cp ../.env.example .env && npm ci && npm run start
- Quickstart runner logs: /ci/artifacts/quickstart-runner/2026-09/
- PR drafts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842 (Priya)

Comments: this doc is intentionally conversational; we'll refine to a short Confluence playbook once the fixes land. Keep notes here for the team to iterate before a formal write-up.

-- Aisha
